lane_impact: Any stance model with three states is short two. Reversed and Dual are enemy-only (no string-table name, empty chi/cooldown in skilldata) but ship full animation blobs alongside 108_LightStance, 97_BalancedStance and 106_HeavyStance — so they are renderable, not vestigial. ledger_text: Stance system = 3 stances (light / balanced / heavy)
text: Skills 1500 and 1501 are not merely unnamed enemy-only entries — they are two additional STANCES. EnemyElite.init dispatches getMastery(1500) > 0 to setStance(REVERSED_STANCE) and getMastery(1501) > 0 to setStance(DUAL_STANCE), with the same dispatch in EnemyPlayer and FriendlyElite, and the build ships dedicated animation payloads for both. The shipped game therefore has FIVE stances (light, balanced, heavy, reversed, dual), not three. Carriers in npcdata: 1500 -> Aboshi (:3662) and Magoichi (:3898); 1501 -> Gojo Takamori (:3934 and :3956).

quote: MCSPlayer.as:3347 'var fireDamage:int = damageObj.fireDamage - STAT_FIREDEF;' :3348 waterDamage-STAT_WATERDEF :3349 windDamage-STAT_WINDDEF :3350 earthDamage-STAT_EARTHDEF (each floored at 1 if the attack carried that element, else clamped to 0, :3351-3357) · :3415 'damage -= this.getDefense();' (physical only) · :3420 'setHP(getHP() - (damage + fireDamage + windDamage + waterDamage + earthDamage));' · StatsManager.as:1836 'player.initElementDefenseStats(getPlayerStats(STAT_WATERATK) + findBonusStat(STAT_FIREDEF), getPlayerStats(STAT_EARTHATK) + findBonusStat(STAT_WINDDEF), getPlayerStats(STAT_WINDATK) + findBonusStat(STAT_WATERDEF), getPlayerStats(STAT_FIREATK) + findBonusStat(STAT_EARTHDEF));' · web constants match one-for-one: §1t1235s0§=28=FIREATK, §1t1236s0§=29=WINDATK, §1t1237s0§=30=WATERATK, §1t1238s0§=31=EARTHATK, §1t1239s0§=200=FIREDEF through §1t1242s0§=203=EARTHDEF
text: Elemental damage bypasses the DEF stat entirely and runs a parallel four-channel pipeline whose per-element defense is CROSS-WIRED to the opposite element's ATK stat — fireDef=waterAtk, windDef=earthAtk, waterDef=windAtk, earthDef=fireAtk — which is the elemental ATK-vs-DEF formula the rebirth-elements ledger lists as blocker ②.
